terrain.description: lush magical grass, root corners, tiny flowers, center kept readable for units
cool charcoal soil and dark scorched grass, matte and dusty, with only two or three small dull rust-orange cracks; definitely not lava, not molten, not glowing brightly

soft slate magical meadow/stone neutral ground with no element dominance
